## Scope note

`git-guard` is intentionally narrow — it focuses on GitHub Personal Access Tokens and their security. Feature requests that broaden the scope beyond GitHub tokens (e.g., AWS keys, Stripe keys, general secret detection) will likely be declined. See the [FAQ](https://github.com/0xshaikh/git-guard#faq) for rationale.
